acceptance_criteria: Device discovery and collection succeeds without TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING
SSH Host Key trust is properly established

baseline.observed: Adding a device fails with connect_failed: host_key_rejected: TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING
baseline.what_exists: SSH trust is missing or failing to be recorded during discovery

invariants: No security weakening (do not disable strict host key checking globally)
report.objective: Fix the TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING error when adding/discovering a device. Ensure the host key is properly fetched and stored in DeviceTrustRepository during the discovery phase.
requirements: Fix the TRUST_ENTRY_MISSING error on device discovery and collection.
